name: Amaya Residences
pinSource: Developer's own project page (karmadevelopers.com/projects/amaya-residences) embeds a Google Maps place marker q=35.04773,34.00749 (a marker, not a camera position). Cross-checked against the brochure's aerial: the plot sits on a main road between Paralimni and Kapparis; OSM puts Agia Triada beach ~1.5 km and Skoutari/Malama ~1.1 km away (developer says 1.2 / 1.3 km), so consistent to a few hundred metres. Medium-high confidence; not a surveyed plot centroid.
amenities: Communal outdoor swimming pool with sun deck
EV charging provision for every parking space
Air-conditioning provision (split units) in living area and bedrooms
facts: Amaya Residences is an off-plan apartment complex in Kapparis, Famagusta district, between Paralimni and Protaras.
The scheme comprises 37 units in two blocks: 36 one- and two-bedroom apartments (12 in Block A, 24 in Block B) plus one 150 m² commercial shop.

One-bedroom apartments have one bathroom and covered verandas of about 14 m²; two-bedroom apartments have two bathrooms and covered verandas of about 25-30 m²; some ground-floor units add uncovered verandas.
The site plan shows a communal swimming pool with sun deck between the two blocks, a private access road and covered parking at ground/piloti level.

Every apartment carries an A-class Energy Performance Certificate; the building envelope is insulated to Cyprus Energy Department requirements and windows are thermal aluminium frames with double glazing.

Finishes include ceramic floor tiles, porcelain-slab kitchen worktops and backsplash, soft-close kitchen cupboards, laminate fitted wardrobes and imported sanitary ware with walk-in showers and channel drains.
Each apartment gets its own solar water-heating system, a hot-water return pump, AC split-unit provision in the living area and all bedrooms, and an EV-charging provision at its parking space.

The developer states distances of 1.2 km to the nearest beach (Ayia Triada), 600 m to restaurants and shops, 250 m to a supermarket, 3.5 km to the general hospital, 2.6 km to Paralimni Marina and 45 km to Larnaca Airport.
A full turnkey furnishing package, house cleaning and rental services are offered as options on request.

conflicts: Size range: description.docx says buildable area 66-123 m²; website and presentation say 66-150 m² (the 150 m² is the commercial shop). Price list gives internal areas (52-53.5 m² 1-bed, 84 m² 2-bed); the website figures are total buildable area incl. common share, so not directly comparable.
Availability: the developer website (checked 2026-11-12) also shows A104 and A203 as 'Available', plus several Block B units; the price list is the source of truth for what is for sale.
Website availability table has apparent typos: B302 listed as 1-bed with 98.20 m² buildable, B304 as 2-bed with 78.80 m² (all siblings are 67.7 / 109.3 m²).
Beach distance: Malama Beach is given as 1.3 km on the Google-map image but 1.2 km on the aerial image; nearest beach (Ayia Triada) 1.2 km in both.
Pool: the General Technical Specifications do not mention the pool, but the presentation, material specification, site layout and price list all do.
